---
pagetitle: "tmux cheatsheet"
format:
  typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    mainfont: "Fira Sans"
    fontsize: 9pt
    margin:
      x: 0.45in
      y: 0.4in
---

<!--
  One-page cheatsheet for tmux/tmux.conf.
  Render:  quarto render cheatsheet.qmd      (writes cheatsheet.pdf)
  The layout is written directly in Typst; edit the rows in the sections below.
  A row is (custom?, keys, action). `true` marks a binding or setting that
  comes from tmux.conf; `false` marks a stock tmux default.
-->

```{=typst}
#let navy  = rgb("#1f3a5f")
#let gold  = rgb("#c8922a")
#let muted = luma(95)
#let mono  = "Fira Mono"

#set page(flipped: true, numbering: none, margin: (x: 0.45in, y: 0.4in))
#set text(font: "Fira Sans", size: 10pt)
#set par(leading: 0.5em, spacing: 0.6em, justify: false)

// ---- building blocks -------------------------------------------------------

#let cap(body, fill: luma(244), stroke: luma(160), ink: black) = box(
  inset: (x: 4pt), outset: (y: 3pt), radius: 2.5pt,
  fill: fill, stroke: 0.5pt + stroke,
  text(font: mono, size: 9pt, fill: ink, body),
)
#let P = cap("P", fill: navy, stroke: navy, ink: white)

// k("P", "c") draws a chord; the string "P" becomes the prefix cap.
#let k(..keys) = keys.pos().map(x => if x == "P" { P } else { cap(x) }).join(h(2.5pt))
#let alt = text(fill: muted, size: 9pt, "/")
#let dot = box(circle(radius: 2.3pt, fill: gold), baseline: -1.4pt)
#let cmd(s) = text(font: mono, size: 8.8pt, s)

#let heading-bar(title) = block(
  width: 100%, below: 7pt, inset: (bottom: 4pt),
  stroke: (bottom: 0.7pt + navy),
  text(weight: "bold", size: 10pt, fill: navy, tracking: 0.6pt, upper(title)),
)

#let rows(items) = grid(
  columns: (9pt, auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: (0pt, 9pt),
  row-gutter: 8.5pt,
  align: (left + horizon, left + horizon, left + horizon),
  ..items.map(r => (if r.at(0) { dot } else { [] }, r.at(1), r.at(2))).flatten()
)

// A section is a heading, an optional note, then one or more groups of rows.
#let sec(title, ..groups, note: none) = block(breakable: false, width: 100%, below: 18pt)[
  #heading-bar(title)
  #if note != none { block(below: 8pt, text(size: 8.5pt, fill: muted, note)) }
  #groups.pos().map(rows).join(v(4pt))
]

// ---- header ----------------------------------------------------------------

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  align: (left + bottom, right + bottom),
  [
    #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[tmux]
    #h(4pt)
    #text(size: 20pt, weight: "light", fill: muted)[cheatsheet]
  ],
  text(size: 9pt)[
    #P #h(3pt) prefix, #cap("C-a") (press, release, then the next key)
    #h(12pt)
    #dot #h(3pt) defined in #cmd("tmux.conf") #h(4pt)
    #text(fill: muted)[unmarked rows are tmux defaults]
  ],
)
#v(-2pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + gold)
#v(4pt)

// ---- body ------------------------------------------------------------------

#columns(3, gutter: 22pt)[

#sec("Sessions", note: [One session per project. Detach instead of quitting.], (
  (false, cmd("tmux new -s proj"),          [new session]),
  (false, cmd("tmux ls"),                   [list sessions]),
  (false, cmd("tmux a -t proj"),            [reattach]),
  (false, cmd("tmux kill-session -t proj"), [tear one down]),
), (
  (false, k("P", "d"),                      [detach, leave it running]),
  (false, k("P", "s"),                      [pick a session from a list]),
  (false, [#k("P", "(") #alt #k("P", ")")],  [previous / next session]),
  (false, k("P", "$"),                      [rename the session]),
))

#sec("Windows", note: [Numbered from 1. #cmd("C-S-←/→") and #cmd("F1") take no prefix.], (
  (true,  k("P", "c"),                       [new window, same dir]),
  (false, [#k("P", "n") #alt #k("P", "p")],   [next / previous window]),
  (false, [#k("P", "1") … #k("9")],          [jump to window by number]),
  (false, k("P", "w"),                       [pick a window from a list]),
  (false, k("P", ","),                       [rename the window]),
  (true,  [#k("C-S-←") #alt #k("C-S-→")], [move window left / right]),
  (true,  k("F1"),                           [renumber, closing gaps]),
  (false, k("P", "&"),                       [kill the window]),
))

#colbreak()

#sec("Panes", note: [Mouse is on: click to focus, drag a border to resize. \ "Same dir" is the active pane's working directory.], (
  (true,  k("P", "%"),                       [split left / right, same dir]),
  (true,  k("P", "\""),                      [split top / bottom, same dir]),
  (false, [#P #h(2.5pt) #cap("←") #cap("↓") #cap("↑") #cap("→")], [move between panes]),
  (false, k("P", "o"),                       [next pane]),
  (false, k("P", "z"),                       [zoom / unzoom the pane]),
  (false, [#k("P", "{") #alt #k("P", "}")],   [swap with previous / next]),
  (false, k("P", "Space"),                   [cycle through layouts]),
  (false, k("P", "!"),                       [break pane into a window]),
  (false, k("P", "x"),                       [kill the pane]),
))

#sec("Popups", note: [Floating scratch windows. They close when the command exits.], (
  (true, k("P", "C-t"), [#cmd("zsh"), same dir]),
  (true, k("P", "C-j"), [#cmd("julia --project=.")]),
  (true, k("P", "C-p"), [#cmd("ipython")]),
  (true, k("P", "C-z"), [#cmd("nvim ~/.zshrc")]),
))

#colbreak()

#sec("Copy mode", note: [Vi keys. Scrollback is 100,000 lines.], (
  (false, k("P", "["),                       [enter copy mode]),
  (true,  [mouse wheel],                     [enter copy mode and scroll]),
  (false, [#cap("h") #cap("j") #cap("k") #cap("l")], [move the cursor]),
  (false, [#k("C-u") #alt #k("C-d")],         [half page up / down]),
  (false, [#k("g") #alt #k("G")],             [top / bottom of history]),
  (false, [#k("/") #alt #k("?")],             [search forward / backward]),
  (false, [#k("n") #alt #k("N")],             [next / previous match]),
  (false, k("Space"),                        [start selection]),
  (false, k("Enter"),                        [copy selection and leave]),
  (false, k("q"),                            [leave copy mode]),
  (false, k("P", "]"),                       [paste]),
))

#sec("Config", (
  (true,  k("P", "r"),   [reload #cmd("tmux.conf")]),
  (true,  k("P", "C-a"), [send a literal #cmd("C-a") to the program]),
  (false, k("P", "?"),   [list every key binding]),
  (false, k("P", ":"),   [tmux command prompt]),
))

#block(breakable: false, width: 100%, inset: 9pt, radius: 3pt, fill: luma(246))[
  #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.5pt, fill: navy)[Settings worth remembering]
  #set text(size: 9pt)
  #set list(marker: text(fill: gold)[•], indent: 0pt, body-indent: 5pt, spacing: 5pt)
  - #cmd("escape-time 0"): Esc is instant in Neovim.
  - Focus events and extended keys (#cmd("csi-u")) are on, so programs see focus changes and modifier combos.
  - The terminal title follows the active pane's title.
  - Status line: session on the left, host on the right. Catppuccin Mocha; needs a Nerd Font.
]

]

#place(bottom + right, text(size: 7.5pt, fill: muted)[
  Source: #cmd("~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf")
])
```
